about: What each persisted interact.json id MEANS (RELEASE_SYSTEM_REVIEW_2026-10-08 H2). Bump `meaning` and set `since` to the release that first ships the new meaning whenever the firmware changes how a saved value is read or written (packing, units, enum, range), even when interact.json does not change. `since` is a release tag with a CHANGELOG heading, or the upcoming release's tag. Baseline: earlier history is not tracked before the first release listed. tools/tau_compat.py reports an id as changed when its `since` is later than the previous release, and refuses a release whose interact.json persists an id missing here or named differently. Never reuse an id: give a new meaning a new id when the format allows it. Tau Gallery: the ids are the Gallery's own from its first release (v1.0.0); the ones the player used are listed as unused.

10.name: (internal) playback
10.what: (Gallery) word 0: bits 30-27 the layout version (GS_LAYOUT_VERSION in fw2/gallery/gallery_settings.h; anything else means the file is not ours and the defaults are used)

11.name: (internal) appearance
11.what: (Gallery) word 1: accent colour bits 4-0 (0-18), theme bits 10-5, polarity bit 11 (0 dark, 1 light); bits 14-12 reserved and kept

12.name: (internal) audio
12.what: (Gallery) word 2: bit 0 resume OFF, stored inverted (a fresh card resumes)

15.name: (internal) meters 1
15.what: (Gallery) word 5: bits 30-0 the CRC-32 of the path of the last picture shown

16.name: (internal) meters 2
16.what: (Gallery) word 6: bits 30-0 the index number of the last picture shown

20.name: (internal) tuning A 1
20.what: (Gallery) word 8: Gallery look settings: grid size bits 1-0 (0 4x3, 1 5x4, 2 6x4, 3 8x6), dither bits 3-2 stored as (dither + 2) % 3 so the default 0 is ordered (1 ordered + moving, 2 off), colour preset bits 6-4 (0 normal, 1 bright, 2 contrast, 3 midtones, 4 faded, 5 warm, 6 cool, 7 invert)
